GET /task/{id}/comment enumerates the task's comments, zero-or-more results, no mutation.

files.update with removeParents/addParents relocates the file — a recoverable change of external state (precedence-2 "move").

POSTs to list/{list_id}/taskTemplate/{template_id}, instantiating a new task.

GET team/{workspace_id}/task with assignee/tag/page/order filters — zero-or-more enumeration, no mutation.
GET team/{workspace_id}/time_entries with date/assignee/scope query filters — zero-or-more enumeration.

GET task/{task_id} fetches one specific known resource by ID.
PUT task/{task_id} changes fields; the rem_assignee path only removes a participant from a surviving task (wave-2 reversible ruling).

GET team/{workspace_id}/time_entries with date-range/assignee/scope query — zero-or-more enumeration.

PUT team/{workspace_id}/time_entries/{timer_id} with only the supplied fields — recoverable field change, no wipe.
PATCHes files.update with {trashed:false}, restoring the file to active state — changes external state recoverably.
Metadata-only files.update of name/description/starred; nothing removed, so precedence-2 WRITE.
Lists permissions only to resolve the ID, then permissions.update changes the role in place — never deletes a grant.
replies.update rewrites the reply content in place (no delete step), so wave-2 in-place-replace keeps it WRITE.
drives.update sets a new name on an existing shared drive — recoverable change to external state.

drive.files.copy creates a new file in the target folder; source untouched.
drive.files.get addresses one specific resource by exact ID and returns it or null — no mutation.

files.update with addParents/removeParents re-parents the file; 'move' is an explicit precedence-2 WRITE and the file survives.

permissions.create adds an anyone-with-link grant; the follow-up files.get/download is only for building the returned URL.
drive.files.create streams the file body into Drive, creating a new file.

GET task/bulk_time_in_status/task_ids for a caller-supplied set of exact task IDs — batch of exact-unique-key lookups (wave-3), no query/filtering.
GET task/{id}/member reads the fixed membership sub-resource of one task addressed by exact ID, with no query criteria.
GET task/{id} retrieves one specific task by ID, no mutation.
POST task/{id}/link/{links_to} creates an association between two tasks.
GET list/{id}/task with paging/ordering/include-closed params enumerates zero-or-more tasks.
GET team/{id}/task with assignee/tag/space/folder/list filters enumerates matching tasks workspace-wide.
PUT workspaces/{ws}/tasks/{id}/home_list/{dest} re-homes the task — a recoverable move.
DELETE task/{id}/tag/{name} detaches a reversible marker; task and space tag both survive and Add Tag To Task restores it (wave-1 rule).

PUT task/{id} with {status} updates the task's status field.
DELETE task/{id}/link/{links_to} removes only the association; both tasks survive and Link Tasks restores it.

drive.replies.delete permanently removes the reply content; a retry cannot restore it.
drive.drives.delete permanently removes the shared drive.

drive.files.emptyTrash purges every trashed file account-wide (or per shared drive); irreversible.
